heroHeadline: Pakistan Security Forces Kill 11 More Militants in Bannu, South Waziristan, Khuzdar IBOs
heroSubtitle: August 27, 2026 is Day 9,090 since the US launched Operation Enduring Freedom and Day 184 of Pakistan's Operation Ghazab lil-Haq. Pakistani security forces killed 11 militants today in fresh intelligence-based operations: 2 Fitna al-Khawarij (TTP-affiliated) fighters in Bannu, whose hideout was demolished; 5 more Fitna al-Khawarij militants tracked and killed in the Ladha area of South Waziristan; and 4 Fitna al-Hindustan (India-linked separatist) militants killed with quadcopter support in the Sasool area of Khuzdar, Balochistan. The operations continue under the 'Radd-ul-Fitna 3' and 'Azm-e-Istehkam' campaigns and follow an August 21 nationwide sweep that killed 49 militants — Pakistan's largest single-day IBO toll since the June cross-border strike pause. President Asif Ali Zardari said eliminating terrorist elements 'operating with foreign backing' remains essential for national security, while PM Shehbaz Sharif and Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi both commended the security forces. No new cross-border strikes have occurred since the June 28-29 Chamkani/Gyan/Marawara episode, and no formal ceasefire or Urumqi Round 2 meeting has been confirmed; the domestic counter-insurgency tempo remains elevated even as the cross-border track stays quiet.
